yaml.title: About
yaml.description: Data scientist and R/Shiny developer with a PhD in Finance.

markdown.markdown:
Hi, I'm Wlademir Ribeiro Prates.

I'm a data scientist and R/Shiny developer. I have built machine learning solutions and data applications for business problems in large companies, and I hold a PhD and a Master's in Finance from UFSC, where I researched behavioral finance and capital markets.

This site is where I collect what I learn: applied analyses with code, notes on taking data applications to production, and reflections on building a career in data.


- **R and Shiny**, from exploratory analysis to applications used in production.
- **Machine learning applied to business problems**, with attention to whether the model actually changes a decision.
- **Reproducible reporting** with Quarto and R Markdown.
- **Finance and behavioral economics** as the analytical background behind much of my work.

## Book

I wrote [O Manual do Cientista de Dados](https://wrprates.github.io/o-manual-do-cientista-de-dados/), a free and open handbook in Portuguese about data science in practice: statistics, modeling, visualization and the reasoning behind them. It is an ongoing project, with source and contributions on [GitHub](https://github.com/wrprates/o-manual-do-cientista-de-dados).

## Research

Before moving to industry, I did academic research in behavioral finance and capital markets at UFSC, mostly on the disposition effect and how investors decide under risk. Selected papers:

- Dorow, A., da Costa, N., Takase, E., **Prates, W. R.** & Da Silva, S. (2018). [On the neural substrates of the disposition effect and return performance](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbef.2017.12.003). *Journal of Behavioral and Experimental Finance*.
- **Prates, W. R.**, da Costa, N. & Dorow, A. (2017). [Risk aversion, the disposition effect, and group decision making: an experimental analysis](https://doi.org/10.1002/mde.2843). *Managerial and Decision Economics*.
- **Prates, W. R.**, da Costa, N., Armada, M. J. R. & Da Silva, S. (2019). [Propensity to sell stocks in an artificial stock market](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0215685). *PLoS ONE*.
- **Prates, W. R.**, da Costa, N. & Santos, A. P. (2019). [Efeito disposição: propensão à venda de investidores individuais e institucionais](https://doi.org/10.5935/0034-7140.20190005). *Revista Brasileira de Economia*.

The full list is on [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=pt-BR&user=DIaC850AAAAJ).

## Education

- 2012–2016 — PhD in Finance, UFSC
- 2010–2012 — Master's in Finance, UFSC
- 2006–2009 — Bachelor's in Business Administration, Anhanguera

## Get in touch

The best place to reach me is [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/wlademir-ribeiro-prates/). For shorter, more informal content, I'm on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/datamundo.cientista/) and [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@wlademir).
